messages:
maya: quick callout: refactor will change batcher internals. we need a minimal, auditable degradation graph before merge

al: agree. minimal graph: coalesce -> microqueue -> quant -> shed. each edge with condition, min_stay_ms, and telemetry_tag

zhen: important: evaluation must not add latency in enqueue. plan: cached per-tenant decision + async refresh tick. only a tiny fast-path predicate allowed on enqueue

maya: also require invariants: no silent starvation and bounded flips (min_dwell + backoff). make defaults conservative

sre-bot: alert: node kv_miss spikes seen. recommend node-level fallback that short-circuits per-tenant decisions when headroom < 0.1

tess: ops wants: force-mode via console (RBAC), audit log entries, and response header X-Redwood-Mode when degraded

al: testing plan: unit tests for graph, simulation with multi-tenant traces, canary rollout behind feature flag

zhen: implementation: admission lib (pluggable) compiles YAML policy at build; runtime reads compact form. decisions emit metric scheduler.mode_transition{from,to,reason}

maya: i'll draft RFC followup with examples and migration steps. keep launch conservative. thanks all :white_check_mark:
